PlayerIdService.luau.description: Assigns stable, recycled uint8 IDs to current players. IDs replicate through a Player attribute and can be sent directly through compact network schemas. Public entry points include `PlayerIdService.Init`, `PlayerIdService.Start`, `PlayerIdService.GetId`, `PlayerIdService.Observe`, `PlayerIdService.GetPlayer`, `PlayerIdService.RefreshIds`, `PlayerIdService.SetIds`, `PlayerIdService.Destroy`.
